name: portal-app
_build_output_note: Firebase Hosting serves portal-app/build at the site ROOT, so assets live at /static/* (root firebase.json caches /static/** immutably). Vite's defaults are dist/ + assets/, so vite.config.js overrides build.outDir/assetsDir to keep the deploy contract from CRA unchanged. `base` must stay '/' - the router basename is /diya-ed, but that is a URL prefix only, not a directory on the host (issue #421).
_overrides_note: @firebase/firestore (still, as of firebase@12.19) pins @grpc/grpc-js ~1.9, which carries high-severity advisories and fails `npm audit --audit-level=high` - the CI dependency-audit job blocks on that as of #503. grpc-js is reachable only from @firebase/*'s Node builds, not the browser bundle this app ships, so it is pinned forward within 1.x. Drop the override once firebase's own range reaches a patched grpc-js. (firebase@10 needed the same for undici; firebase@12 ships a patched undici, so that override was removed.)
_typescript_note: TypeScript 7 ships no programmatic API (expected in 7.1), and typescript-eslint imports `typescript` for one - its peer range stops at <6.1. So, per Microsoft's 'running side by side with TypeScript 6.0' guidance: `typescript` is aliased to @typescript/typescript6 (the 6.0 API, for typescript-eslint), and @typescript/native is TypeScript 7, which provides the `tsc` that `npm run typecheck` runs. Collapse both back to a plain `typescript` once typescript-eslint supports TS 7 (typescript-eslint#10940). npm's ERESOLVE peer warning on install is expected.
